Describe the change and why it belongs in `llmkit-go`.

## Checklist

- [ ] Public API changes are documented in `README.md`, package docs, or `CHANGELOG.md`.
- [ ] Dependency changes are reflected in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`.
- [ ] `gofmt`, `go vet ./...`, and `go test ./...` pass.
- [ ] No credentials, private paths, customer data, or provider-specific policy were added.
